mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain or accelerate rate hikes, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the average 20d return in low-unemployment periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue growth and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0, following a prior 3-month upward trend, signals an imminent supply shock or manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 105.0 and INDPRO declined > 2.0pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the average 5d return in contraction periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal broad-based demand strength that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stagnant or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals delayed monetary policy response, increasing real rate uncertainty and equity risk premiums, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS unchanged or falling
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market recovery that increases consumer spending and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 490 billion dollars, combined with stable or rising industrial production (INDPRO), signals resilient demand and supply chain stability that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
